candidate.mistake_reason: The Planner failed to recognize that the available tools (WebSurfer, FileSurfer, Coder, CodeExecutor) are insufficient for extracting specific genealogical data from static images or search result snippets. The Planner repeatedly instructed the WebSurfer to 'click' on images or 'extract' names from visual family trees, which a text-based browser agent cannot do without OCR capabilities or specific image analysis tools. This fundamental misunderstanding of the tool's limitations led to a futile search loop.
candidate.first_mistake: This is the first mistake because the initial strategy (Step 1) set the entire direction of the task towards searching for and clicking on images, rather than searching for text-based genealogical records or using code to parse data. This flawed approach persisted throughout the entire conversation, preventing any actual data extraction.
candidate.mistake_not_corrected: The mistake was never corrected because the Planner continued to issue the same type of instructions (click images, extract from visuals) in every subsequent step (Steps 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, 19). The WebSurfer agents, limited to browsing text and metadata, could not fulfill these impossible instructions, but the Planner never adjusted the strategy to use the Coder agent to write a script for searching or to acknowledge the lack of text data.
